# Colour tokens

The column surface is a light lift over the page background. The active
column gets an accent border; inactive columns keep a faint hairline.

## Tokens

- `surface` — background mixed with text at 2–5%.
- `border` — 14% text for inactive, 48% accent for active.
- `selection` — accent wash plus a 2 px leading bar.

> A very thin scroll rail appears at the right edge when a column has more
> rows than fit.
